key_insight: A hybrid TFT–N-BEATS model combines short-term dynamics with long-term patterns to improve multi-horizon photovoltaic power forecasting.
engineering_relevance: More accurate forecasts can support grid stability, energy scheduling, and coordinated PV–battery–grid operation.
method: TFT learns short-term dependencies and dynamic feature importance.
N-BEATS decomposes long-term trends and seasonality.
Adaptive attention fuses both branches to forecast 30-minute to 24-hour horizons.
evidence_signal: On multi-year DKASC datasets, the abstract reports RMSE values of 42.35–52.29, a 35–40% reduction versus TFT, and MAPE below 5%.
watch_item: Generalization beyond DKASC remains unestablished in the abstract; this study concerns PV power forecasting, not perovskite cell materials.
paper_title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
